title: Praise the Lord O My Soul
Make a Good Tree in Me
Is it Faith
lyrics: **Title: Is It Faith?** **Verse 1** I say I trust Your holy Word, (8) Yet fear still fills my mind. (6) I ask You, Lord, to lead my steps, (8) Then leave Your way behind. (6) **Verse 2** You said a mustard seed could move (8) The mountains from their place. (6) But often I depend upon (8) My effort, not Your grace. (6) **Verse 3** I pray and lay my burdens down, (8) Then lift them up once more. (6) I claim the promises You gave, (8) Yet worry as before. (6) **Verse 4** If I believe Your every word, (8) Why do I doubt and fear? (6) Why do I search for other plans (8) When You are always near? (6) **Chorus** Lord, teach my heart what faith can be, (8) To trust and then obey. (6) Not leaning on my strength alone, (8) But following Your way. (6) **Verse 5** The mountain moves not by my might, (8) Nor by the faith I show. (6) It moves because the God I serve (8) Commands it where to go. (6) **Final Chorus** Lord, grow this tiny seed in me, (8) Though small it now may be. (6) For mustard-seed faith placed in You (8) Is all You'll ask of me. (6)

title: Intertwined
lyrics: Verse 1 I was iron in the fire Unshaped, unrefined You were mercy in the waiting Like a hand in mine I don't lead with all the answers I just follow where He goes Learning strength is in the breaking And the love that chose Verse 2 I was breath inside the silence You were steady in the storm Every fear I tried to carry You were pulling me toward I don't stand in perfect courage But I'm held in perfect grace And the God who wrote our story Is the one we chase Pre-Chorus Not two roads, not two names Not two hearts untamed We are called into the same flame Chorus We are intertwined Like the cross where love was proven Your heart in mine Where the broken things are woven Side by side Through the shadow and the light We are two made one By the Father, Spirit, Son Verse 3 I will lay my life around you Like a shelter in the rain I will build my trust upon you Even when I feel the pain Not a crown, but just a promise Not a silence, but a voice We are choosing every moment We are choosing this for life Chorus We are intertwined Like the cross where love was proven Your heart in mine Where the broken things are woven Side by side Through the shadow and the light We are two made one By the Father, Spirit, Son Bridge I will cover you in kindness I will meet you in the fight When you're weak When you're weary We will stand in holy light Every scar becomes a story Every trial turns to grace We are forged into a union Nothing time could ever break Final Chorus We are intertwined Like the cross where love was proven Your heart in mine Where the broken things are woven Side by side Through the fire and the refining We are two made one And forever un-dividing Outro Still becoming... Still becoming one... Held together... By the Holy One...

title: Where the Worm Does not Die
Promise in the Sky
lyrics: Verse 1 When all the earth was filled with rain And skies were dark and gray You placed a promise in the clouds To guide us on our way Verse 2 You said the storms would not remain Your mercy would be near A sign of hope above the earth So we would never fear Verse 3 When clouds return and thunder rolls And trouble fills the day I look and see Your promise there Reminding me Your way Verse 4 From age to age Your promise stands No storm can wash away The mercy written in the sky Still speaks to us today Pre-Chorus When storms are rising over me And I can't see the end I look and see Your promise there You always will defend Chorus You set Your promise in the sky So I would never fear After every storm I see Your mercy shining near You set Your promise in the sky So all the world would know You remember every soul And never let us go Bridge You remember You remember Every promise that You made You remember You remember Mercy never fades You remember You remember Even when the sky is gray You remember You remember You will make a way
